_help.about: [NOT WIRED YET — design §DL] Tomes: real philosophical texts you can find and read (3 Oct, Mike by voice: "I would like to add some philosophical texts that you might be able to find randomly. For example, the I Ching"). Rare finds live in ruins (§AW): a tome lies where someone left it, most often at a delve's heart (§CJ.3), never in a chest. It is read while you carry it, opening like the log (in the internal frame, in the HUD's font) a page at a time; the log notes the find (hud.json log_more: tome). Public-domain translations only. No systems yet (Mike: "we might implement some systems based on it later, but we're going to wait on that for now"): the I Ching coin cast already in the game (scripts/core/iching.gd, the rare-event RNG) is a separate thing. Restart after editing.
_help.find: at: where tomes lie; share_of_hearts: of the delves' hearts, how many hold a tome instead of another find. First guesses.
_help.tomes: id; title (its name in play); what it is; translation (the public-domain one used) and not (the one not to use); pages (how it divides); text_file (the text itself, one file per tome under data/tomes/: a later data job, filled from a public-domain edition and checked against it); filled: whether the text is in yet.
_help.found_at: found_at on a tome overrides find.at for that tome (§DQ: the second tome lies at the pass gate).

tomes.title: The Book of Changes
tomes.what: The I Ching: sixty-four hexagrams, each with its judgement and the texts of its six lines.
tomes.translation: James Legge, The Yî King, The Sacred Books of the East vol. 16 (Oxford, 1882): public domain.
tomes.not: Not Richard Wilhelm's translation in Cary F. Baynes's English (1950), still in copyright.

tomes.title: The Book of the Way
tomes.what: The Tao Te Ching: eighty-one short chapters.
tomes.translation: James Legge, The Tâo Teh King, The Sacred Books of the East vol. 39 (Oxford, 1891): public domain.
tomes.not: Not any twentieth-century translation (Waley 1934, Feng and English 1972, Mitchell 1988), all in copyright.
tomes._note: [NOT WIRED YET — design §DQ] Found at the gate at the pass the rider is heading for (uniques.json road_regulars.ox_rider.gate), not at a delve's heart; a first guess with the gate itself.
